groups.name: Iconic fictional small towns from popular TV dramas and comedies
groups.explanation: Storybrooke is the cursed town in Once Upon a Time; Pawnee is the Indiana town in Parks and Recreation; Bluebell is the Alabama town in Hart of Dixie; Rosewood is the Pennsylvania town in Pretty Little Liars. All are beloved fictional TV towns that serve as the central setting of their respective series.

groups.name: Female TV creators who also served as showrunner on their flagship series
groups.explanation: Sharon Horgan co-created and showran Catastrophe and created Bad Sisters; Shonda Rhimes created and showran Grey's Anatomy and Scandal; Jenji Kohan created and showran Weeds and Orange Is the New Black; Marti Noxon created and showran UnREAL and Dietland. All four are women who held both creator and showrunner credits on major prestige television series.

groups.name: Characters and locations from Frontier (Netflix/Discovery Canada)
groups.explanation: All four tiles are from the Netflix/Discovery Canada historical drama Frontier: Declan Harp (Jason Momoa) is the half-Irish, half-Cree protagonist; Lord Benton (Alun Armstrong) is the brutal antagonist and Governor of Fort James; Grace Emberly (Jessica Matten) is a key recurring character; and Fort James is the Hudson's Bay Company stronghold that serves as the central location of conflict throughout the series.

groups.name: TV's beloved tech and forensics support characters — the team's indispensable genius in the chair
groups.explanation: Penelope García (Criminal Minds) is the BAU's eccentric computer analyst; Hardison (Leverage) is the team's hacker and tech expert; Felicity Smoak (Arrow) is the IT genius who becomes Team Arrow's operations lead; Abby Sciuto (NCIS) is the beloved forensic scientist in her iconic lab. All four are celebrated in-universe as irreplaceable technical geniuses who support their team from behind a screen rather than in the field, and all four became fan favorites whose personalities often overshadowed their ostensibly supporting roles.
